answer: The owner registers a sealed succession statement with a notary, naming a successor who can claim the account only after presenting the notary attestation plus proof of the triggering event. A Sybil attacker cannot forge the notary seal or the event proof, so accounts cannot be seized by fake heirs, and each succession leaves an auditable public record. The design treats each recovery as a pigment: small alone, decisive in aggregate. From the timber to the signal, the same rule holds: no proof, no recovery, no exception.
